name: combobox
title: Combobox
description: Searchable single-choice dropdown. Field-shell trigger + portaled listbox filtered by the typed query. Use when Select's static list would exceed ~12 options. v0.12.4 — listbox renders via createPortal(<div fixed>, document.body) with getBoundingClientRect tracking on scroll (capture phase) + resize, escaping every ancestor's overflow context (Showcase frames, <Card padding='none'>, glass surfaces, scroll containers).
